```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)


clinical_file <- "data/clinical_data.csv"
mirna_file <- "data/coad/miRNA_counts_matrix.csv"
out_dir <- "data/DE_results/pre_miRNA/coad"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


clinical_data <- read.csv(
  clinical_file,
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  na.strings = c("NA", "")
)

rownames(clinical_data) <- clinical_data$sample_submitter_id
clinical_data <- clinical_data[!is.na(clinical_data$MSI_TMB), ]

clinical_data$MSI_TMB <- factor(
  clinical_data$MSI_TMB,
  levels = c("MSI-H", "MSS/TMB-H", "MSS/TMB-L"),
  labels = c("MSI_H", "MSS_TMB_H", "MSS_TMB_L")
)


mirna_counts <- as.matrix(read.csv(
  mirna_file,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
))


storage.mode(mirna_counts) <- "numeric"
colnames(mirna_counts) <- substr(colnames(mirna_counts), 1, 16)

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(mirna_counts), rownames(clinical_data))

mirna_counts <- mirna_counts[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
clinical_data <- clinical_data[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]


table(clinical_data$MSI_TMB)


y <- DGEList(
  counts = mirna_counts,
  group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB
)


keep <- filterByExpr(
  y,
  group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB,
  min.count = 5
)

y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]


y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")


design <- model.matrix(~0 + clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
colnames(design) <- levels(clinical_data$MSI_TMB)


y <- estimateDisp(y, design, robust = TRUE)
fit <- glmQLFit(y, design, robust = TRUE)


contrasts <- list(
  MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H = makeContrasts(MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H, levels = design),
  MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = makeContrasts(MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L, levels = design),
  MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = makeContrasts(MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L, levels = design)
)


mirna_results <- lapply(contrasts, function(ct) {
  qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = ct)
  topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table
})


for (name in names(mirna_results)) {
  write.csv(
    mirna_results[[name]],
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".csv"))
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(svglite)

coad_mir_dir <- "data/DE_results/pre_miRNA/coad"
ucec_mir_dir <- "data/DE_results/pre_miRNA/ucec"
plot_dir <- "results/figures/pre_miRNA"

dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 1

read_mir_de <- function(file, contrast_name, dataset, flip_logfc = FALSE) {
  df <- read.csv(file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    rownames_to_column("pre_miRNA") %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  if (flip_logfc) df$logFC <- -df$logFC
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      contrast = contrast_name,
      dataset = dataset,
      sig = FDR <= fdr_cutoff & abs(logFC) >= logfc_cutoff,
      direction = case_when(
        sig & logFC > 0 ~ "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
        sig & logFC < 0 ~ "Down in MSS/TMB-H",
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      ),
      neglog10FDR = -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-300))
    )
}
```

```{r}
coad_mssh_vs_msih <- read_mir_de(
```

```{r}
plot_mir_volcano <- function(df, title, out_file, label_n = 10) {
  label_df <- df %>%
    filter(sig) %>%
    arrange(FDR, desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
    slice_head(n = label_n)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC, y = neglog10FDR)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.75, size = 1.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_cutoff, logfc_cutoff),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_cutoff),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = pre_miRNA),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Up in MSS/TMB-H" = "#D55E00",
      "Down in MSS/TMB-H" = "#0072B2",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    )) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "log2 fold-change",
      y = expression(-log[10]("FDR")),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 6.5, height = 5.2, device = "svg")
  p
}
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)


mirna_file <- "data/coad/miRNA_counts_matrix.csv"

shared_file <- "results/figures/pre_miRNA/shared_pre_miRNAs_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L_COAD_UCEC.csv"

crc_clinical_file <- "data/clinical_data.csv"
ucec_clinical_file <- "data/ucec_clinical.csv"

plot_dir <- "results/figures/pre_miRNA"
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


shared_premir <- read.csv(shared_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)$pre_miRNA
shared_premir <- unique(shared_premir[!is.na(shared_premir)])


crc_clin <- read.csv(
  crc_clinical_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  na.strings = c("NA", "")
) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "CRC")

ucec_clin <- read.csv(
  ucec_clinical_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  na.strings = c("NA", "")
) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "UCEC")

clinical_data <- bind_rows(crc_clin, ucec_clin) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MSI_TMB)) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = sample_submitter_id,
    MSI_TMB = factor(
      MSI_TMB,
      levels = c("MSI-H", "MSS/TMB-H", "MSS/TMB-L")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(sample, dataset, MSI_TMB)


mirna_counts <- as.matrix(read.csv(
  mirna_file,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
))

storage.mode(mirna_counts) <- "numeric"


colnames(mirna_counts) <- substr(colnames(mirna_counts), 1, 16)


common_samples <- intersect(colnames(mirna_counts), clinical_data$sample)

mirna_counts <- mirna_counts[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
clinical_data <- clinical_data %>%
  filter(sample %in% common_samples) %>%
  arrange(match(sample, common_samples))

mirna_counts <- mirna_counts[, clinical_data$sample, drop = FALSE]


y <- DGEList(
  counts = mirna_counts,
  group = interaction(clinical_data$dataset, clinical_data$MSI_TMB)
)

keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = interaction(clinical_data$dataset, clinical_data$MSI_TMB), min.count = 5)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
mirna_logcpm <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)


missing_premir <- setdiff(shared_premir, rownames(mirna_logcpm))
missing_premir

plot_mat <- mirna_logcpm[
  intersect(shared_premir, rownames(mirna_logcpm)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


plot_df <- as.data.frame(plot_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("pre_miRNA") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -pre_miRNA,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "logCPM"
  ) %>%
  left_join(clinical_data, by = "sample")


summary_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(dataset, pre_miRNA, MSI_TMB) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_logCPM = mean(logCPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(logCPM, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


p_shared_premir <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = MSI_TMB, y = mean_logCPM, fill = MSI_TMB)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_logCPM - sem, ymax = mean_logCPM + sem),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = plot_df,
    aes(x = MSI_TMB, y = logCPM),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.15,
    size = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  facet_grid(dataset ~ pre_miRNA, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "MSI-H" = "#009E73",
    "MSS/TMB-H" = "#D55E00",
    "MSS/TMB-L" = "#0072B2"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of shared pre-miRNAs in CRC and UCEC",
    subtitle = "Shared significant pre-miRNAs from MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L",
    x = NULL,
    y = "TMM-normalized logCPM"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "shared_pre_miRNA_expression_barplots_COAD_UCEC.svg"),
  p_shared_premir,
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  device = "svg"
)

p_shared_premir
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(multiMiR)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)



shared_file <- "results/figures/pre_miRNA/shared_pre_miRNAs_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L_COAD_UCEC.csv"

shared_premir <- read.csv(shared_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)$pre_miRNA
shared_premir <- unique(shared_premir)



premir_to_mature_base <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_replace("^hsa-mir", "hsa-miR") %>%
    str_replace("^hsa-let", "hsa-let")
}

mir_base <- premir_to_mature_base(shared_premir)


mir_query <- unique(c(
  paste0(mir_base, "-5p"),
  paste0(mir_base, "-3p")
))

mir_query
```

```{r}
safe_get_multimir <- function(mir) {
  message("Querying: ", mir)
  
  tryCatch({
    res <- get_multimir(
      mirna = mir,
      table = "validated",
      summary = TRUE
    )
    
    if (is.null(res@data) || nrow(res@data) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    res@data %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(query_miRNA = mir)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Failed: ", mir, " | ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

mir_gene_raw <- map_dfr(mir_query, safe_get_multimir)

mir_gene_df <- mir_gene_raw[, c("mature_mirna_id", "target_symbol", "database")] %>%
  distinct()



mir_gene_df <- mir_gene_df %>%
  mutate(
    pre_miRNA = mature_mirna_id %>%
      str_replace("-5p$", "") %>%
      str_replace("-3p$", "") %>%
      str_replace("^hsa-miR", "hsa-mir")
  )

write.csv(
  mir_gene_df,
  "results/figures/pre_miRNA/pre_miRNA_gene_associations_validated.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
    everything()
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()


shared_mssl_genes <- shared_mssl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_direction = dplyr::case_when(
      CRC > 0 & UCEC > 0 ~ "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
      CRC < 0 & UCEC < 0 ~ "Down in MSS/TMB-H",
      TRUE ~ "Inconsistent"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    target_symbol = Gene,
    gene_logFC_CRC = CRC,
    gene_logFC_UCEC = UCEC,
    consistent,
    gene_direction
  )


genes_supported_by_miRNA <- mir_gene_df_full %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(shared_mssl_genes, by = "target_symbol") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(target_symbol, pre_miRNA, mature_miRNA)


gene_summary <- genes_supported_by_miRNA %>%
  dplyr::group_by(target_symbol, gene_logFC_CRC, gene_logFC_UCEC, gene_direction) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pre_miRNA = dplyr::n_distinct(pre_miRNA),
    pre_miRNAs = paste(sort(unique(pre_miRNA)), collapse = "; "),
    mature_miRNAs = paste(sort(unique(mature_miRNA)), collapse = "; "),
    databases = paste(sort(unique(database)), collapse = "; "),
    support_types = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(support_type))), collapse = "; "),
    pubmed_ids = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(pubmed_id))), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_pre_miRNA), target_symbol)


premir_summary <- genes_supported_by_miRNA %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pre_miRNA, mature_miRNA) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_DE_targets = dplyr::n_distinct(target_symbol),
    DE_targets = paste(sort(unique(target_symbol)), collapse = "; "),
    databases = paste(sort(unique(database)), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_DE_targets), pre_miRNA)


wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "All_associations")
writeData(wb, "All_associations", genes_supported_by_miRNA)

addWorksheet(wb, "Gene_summary")
writeData(wb, "Gene_summary", gene_summary)

addWorksheet(wb, "pre_miRNA_summary")
writeData(wb, "pre_miRNA_summary", premir_summary)

for (sheet in names(wb)) {
  freezePane(wb, sheet, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = 1:30, widths = 18)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)

out_xlsx
```

```{r}
library(gprofiler2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(svglite)

sources_use <- c("GO:BP", "REAC", "CORUM")

go_out_dir <- "results/figures/pre_miRNA"
dir.create(go_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


mir_supported_up_genes <- genes_supported_by_miRNA %>%
  filter(gene_direction == "Up in MSS/TMB-H") %>%
  pull(target_symbol) %>%
  unique()

mir_supported_down_genes <- genes_supported_by_miRNA %>%
  filter(gene_direction == "Down in MSS/TMB-H") %>%
  pull(target_symbol) %>%
  unique()

length(mir_supported_up_genes)
length(mir_supported_down_genes)


run_gost <- function(genes) {
  genes <- unique(genes)
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes)]
  
  if (length(genes) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  gost(
    query = genes,
    organism = "hsapiens",
    sources = sources_use,
    significant = TRUE,
    correction_method = "g_SCS"
  )
}

gost_mir_up <- run_gost(mir_supported_up_genes)
gost_mir_down <- run_gost(mir_supported_down_genes)
```

```{r}
extract_gost <- function(gost_res, comparison, direction, top_n_per_source = 6) {
  if (is.null(gost_res) || is.null(gost_res$result)) return(NULL)
  
  df <- gost_res$result %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
    filter(!grepl(
      "gene expression|transcription|RNA metabolic|cellular process|biological regulation|metabolic process",
      term_name,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ))
  
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    df <- gost_res$result %>%
      filter(!is.na(p_value))
  }
  
  df %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    arrange(p_value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n_per_source) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = comparison,
      direction = direction,
      neglog10_p = -log10(p_value),
      term_label = paste0(source, ": ", stringr::str_trunc(term_name, 70))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      comparison,
      direction,
      source,
      term_id,
      term_name,
      term_label,
      p_value,
      neglog10_p,
      term_size,
      intersection_size,
      precision,
      recall
    )
}

enrich_mir_supported_df <- bind_rows(
  extract_gost(
    gost_mir_up,
    "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L",
    "Up in MSS/TMB-H"
  ),
  extract_gost(
    gost_mir_down,
    "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L",
    "Down in MSS/TMB-H"
  )
)

enrich_mir_supported_df %>%
  count(comparison, direction)

write.csv(
  enrich_mir_supported_df,
  file.path(go_out_dir, "GO_miRNA_supported_DE_genes_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
enrich_mir_supported_df <- enrich_mir_supported_df %>%

p_go_mir_supported <- ggplot(

) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(go_out_dir, "GO_dotplot_miRNA_supported_DE_genes_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.svg"),
  p_go_mir_supported,
  width = 8,
```
